Chancellor, saw NetBrain took a Blackstone investment, named a new CEO, and pushed Agentic NetOps into general use this year.

A reset like that usually raises pipeline expectations faster than a BD team can ramp to cover. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for NetBrain off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chancellor, quick follow-up for NetBrain.

After a new investor and a new CEO, the board's pipeline expectations usually jump faster than global BD headcount can. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings NetBrain needs across your regions, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chancellor, last bit of proof for NetBrain.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how NetBrain's reply rate likely compares to other network software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chancellor, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority during the leadership transition, no problem at all. Timing is everything after a new investor, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a global BD motion? I'll tailor it to NetBrain either way.
